draft.title: The French and Indian War
card: The French and Indian War was fought in North America from 1754 to 1763. It was part of a wider war between Britain and France, called the Seven Years' War in Europe.
Britain won. By the peace treaty of 1763, France gave up most of its land in mainland North America, which removed a major rival from beside the colonies.
The war was costly. Britain finished it with a very large national debt, and troops were still needed in North America to defend the larger territory.
British leaders argued that the colonies had gained from the victory and should help pay for their defence. This led Britain to look to the colonies for money.
draft.remember: Victory over France left Britain in debt, so it turned to the colonies for money.

a.q: Why did the end of the French and Indian War lead Britain to look to the colonies for money?
opts: It had a large debt and thought colonies should share costs
It had lost land and wanted the colonies to repay the loss
It wanted to punish colonies for fighting against Britain
It had no troops left and needed colonists to form an army
a.why: Britain won the war but ended it with a large debt and troops still needed to defend the territory. Its leaders said the colonies had gained from the victory. The option about lost land is wrong because Britain was the winner, and France was the side that gave up land.
a.clue: Think about who won and what the war cost.

b.q: A British official in 1764 says, 'The colonies are safer now, so they should help pay for the war.' Which fact about the war best supports his view?
opts: France gave up most of its mainland North American land
Britain had lost the war and needed money to rebuild
The colonies had refused to send any help to Britain
France had taken over the colonies' elected assemblies
b.why: Britain's win removed France as a rival beside the colonies, so the colonies were safer. This was the basis for asking them to share the cost. The option about losing the war is wrong because Britain won.
b.clue: Which fact shows the colonies gained from the result?

a.best: It had a large debt and thought colonies should share costs

b.best: France gave up most of its mainland North American land
